Subject: Follow-up: Redwood call — procurement path & next steps

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Summary: Greenline is evaluating Redwood for in-product summarization and clinical note embeddings. Key procurement questions are around PO vs card and whether the team needs an AWS Marketplace SKU for vendor consolidation.
- Immediate asks from you: preferred payment path (PO or corporate card), any internal procurement checklist items, and whether a draft MSA/SOW should be circulated to legal now.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share our pricing sheet and a draft SOW for your procurement/legal review (attached pricing-sheet.pdf).
2) Please confirm if Greenline requires marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) or if a standard PO is acceptable.
3) If PO, please share procurement contact & billing address so we can prepare the exact quote.

If helpful, we can put together two purchase paths in parallel: (A) PO + net30 invoice; (B) Marketplace listing + invoice through AWS. That keeps options open and shortens cycle time.

Available to jump on a 15-min call with procurement this week if needed.

Best,

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from procurement and legal: 

- Preference: Greenline prefers to use a PO process. Corporate card purchases are limited to < $5k and this will likely be above that threshold.
- Contract: We will need a copy of your MSA + an SOW that lists deliverables, expected usage bands, and breach/termination clauses. Legal also flagged data handling and audit logs as items to include.
- Marketplace: We are exploring AWS Marketplace for procurement centralization, but it typically adds 1–2 weeks to admin work on our side. If Redwood has a Marketplace SKU, please include that option.
- Terms: Net 30 is standard for us; if Redwood needs different terms let us know.

Timeline: procurement estimates 3–4 weeks once they receive the MSA/SOW and an invoice-ready quote.

Attaching our procurement checklist for reference (greenline-requirements.pdf).

Sophie Reed
Head of Vendor Ops
Greenline Health
